name: Adobe Marketing Agent
description: Adobe Marketing Agent for Claude Enterprise lets you interact with Adobe using natural language. Ask questions, get insights, and take action without leaving your workflow. It understands your intent and connects with Adobe solutions like Real-Time CDP, Journey Optimizer, and Customer Journey Analytics to deliver answers that help teams move faster and work smarter.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Adobe Marketing Agent to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Adobe Marketing Agent to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://aep-ai-ama.adobe.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Adobe Marketing Agent MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adobe Marketing Agent provides these MCP tools: core-context-management-widget, core-set_sandbox, core-set_dataview, core-switch_sandbox_dataview, core-switch_org, core-user_preferences, core-feedback-widget, and core-provide_feedback.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Adobe Marketing Agent?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Adobe Marketing Agent in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.

_published_faq.name: Does Adobe Marketing Agent MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adobe Marketing Agent requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Adobe Marketing Agent is developed by Adobe Inc. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
